{{Top|leg}}
'''Jaffa cider''' was a mulled, pressed [[Foodstuff/Legends|juice]] with a rich fragrance.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|133|jaffa cider}}</ref> [[Pallaxides]], a corporate [[Planet/Legends|world]] owned by [[Tagge Corporation|TaggeCo]], had a three-lobed [[Flower/Legends|flower]] with a scent reminiscent of the cider's.<ref name="Gone to Ground">{{WEGCite|story=Gone To Ground|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
